title: Lumbar FSU stiffness in 8 loading directions (hexapod, follower preload, 37 C) by disc degeneration grade

quantity.name: principal-direction linear stiffness
quantity.definition: slope of the loading branch of the final 0.1 Hz cycle over the stated displacement range (high-stiffness region, not neutral zone); left/right averaged for lateral shear, lateral bending, axial rotation (no L/R difference). Hexapod robot coordinate system aligned to the specimen; displacements/rotations of the upper vertebra relative to the fixed lower vertebra about the disc centre of rotation (determined from axial and lateral radiographs); hybrid position/load control drives the primary axis while minimising the 5 off-axis forces/moments to zero.

source.authors: Amin DB, Sommerfeld D, Lawless IM, Stanley RM, Ding B, Costi JJ
source.sample: 14 lumbar FSUs (L1-2 x4, L2-3 x4, L3-4 x4, L4-5 x2); Thompson grade 3 (mild) n=5, 4 (moderate) n=6, 5 (severe) n=3; human cadaveric lumbar FSUs with posterior elements, mean disc area 1811/1665/1938 mm2 and height 10.1/8.4/7.6 mm (grades 3/4/5)

protocol.summary: Specimens in 37 C PBS with protease inhibitors; 12 h equilibration at a compressive load equivalent to 0.1 MPa nucleus pressure; follower preload equivalent to 0.5 MPa nucleus pressure during all 6DOF tests (external stress = nucleus pressure/1.5, applied to unloaded disc area 0.84*AP*LAT). Each DOF: 5 haversine cycles at 1, 0.1, 0.01 Hz (+ 0.001 Hz) in displacement control on the primary axis with off-axis loads minimised; analysed: final cycle at 0.1 Hz. Order: shears and axial rotation first, then bending, then compression; reference compression and recovery between DOFs.
how_to_simulate: Model the lumbar FSU (with posterior elements); fix the lower vertebra; apply a follower compressive preload equal to (0.5/1.5) MPa x disc area (~0.84*AP*LAT; e.g. ~590 N for 1775 mm2)

Impose the primary displacement about/along the disc centre of rotation with all other 5 DOF load-free (pure displacement on one axis): 0.6 mm shears, 2 deg axial rotation, 3 deg lateral bending, 5 deg flexion, 2 deg extension; for compression load to 1.1 MPa-equivalent stress

Compute stiffness as the slope of the loading curve over the stated range (shear 0.4-0.58 mm; flexion and lateral bending 2-2.8 deg; extension 0.85-1.25 deg; axial rotation 1.5-1.8 deg; compression 0.77-1 MPa)
Compare with the degeneration group matching the model's disc (mild = grade 3 for a healthy-ish model) or the grade-weighted mean
protocol.notes: Coordinate/reference: Hexapod robot coordinate system aligned to the specimen; displacements/rotations of the upper vertebra relative to the fixed lower vertebra about the disc centre of rotation (determined from axial and lateral radiographs); hybrid position/load control drives the primary axis while minimising the 5 off-axis forces/moments to zero. Elderly specimens (64-93 y). 95% CI from figure; sd derived as CI_half/t(0.975,n-1)*sqrt(n) assuming t-based CI. Phase angles (Fig 7) not extracted. Same 14 specimens as Amin 2016a (J Biomech).

extraction.uncertainty: shear +-10 N/mm, compression +-60 N/mm, rotations +-0.15 Nm/deg (pixel analysis at 300 dpi: 1 px = 2.5 N/mm, 19 N/mm, 0.057 Nm/deg); CI half-widths +-2 px
extraction.check_notes: Bars digitised by pixel analysis (bar-top outline centre vs tick-label centres, upper whisker end). Significance brackets initially mis-detected as bar tops/whisker ends (axial rotation moderate, flexion); corrected by requiring the outline to connect to the bar edges and following the whisker continuously. All 24 means and caps then compared visually against the rendered figure (e.g. ant shear mild ~820, cap ~1105; compression severe ~6560, cap ~8800).

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD of the matching degeneration group
